attr.title: Command & Conquer: Red Alert (iPad)
attr.desc: EA's 2010 iPad real-time strategy game, set in the Red Alert 3 universe. Command the Allies, the Soviets or the Empire of the Rising Sun across story campaigns and skirmishes. Runs the original iPad app through touchHLE, with gamepad controls added.
attr.inst: Copy your own decrypted .ipa of Red Alert for iPad into `candcra/gamedata`. See the readme.
